findings.summary: Attempt-1 coverage gap (ComputeEffectiveScale safe-area clamp branch and resolver tolerant-undefined fallback) is closed by two new non-vacuous tests.
findings.detail: BadgeSizePositionTests.SafeAreaClampReducesTheEffectiveScaleOnAShortPoster is a 3-case theory (Medium 3000x120, Large 1000x40, Small 1000x30). In each case ComputeScale * SizeFactor exceeds min(width,height)/(2*OuterInset), so the clamp at BadgeGeometry.cs:163-166 actually binds; the test asserts unclamped > expected and effective == min(width,height)/48, so removing or weakening the clamp would fail it. RendererConfigurationTests.ResolverFallsBackToDefaultsForUndefinedBadgePositionAndSize passes (BadgePosition)99/(BadgeSize)99 through RendererConfigurationResolver.ResolveOutputPolicy and asserts the code-owned defaults (BottomLeft/Medium) plus a defined TopRight/Large case, so a regression that propagated the undefined value would fail it. Both are deterministic and assert concrete values. Focused run: Failed 0, Passed 4, Skipped 0, Total 4.
